info.title: oiseau pourri API
info.description: The game API behind oiseaupourri.ch, consumed by apps/web, apps/dashboard (admin tag) and apps/android. Authentication (/auth/*) is Better Auth and is not described here. Every operation but /api/health needs the session cookie (`better-auth.session_token`, `__Secure-` prefixed over https); native clients also send `Origin: oiseaupourri://app`.
